translations.web: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
translations.bsb: The ocean depths say, ‘It is not in me,’ while the sea declares, ‘It is not with me.’
translations.kjv: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith,
translations.asv: The deep saith, It is not in me; And the sea saith, It is not with me.
